Hey! So Glad You're Here.

Welcome! My name is Lisa "Pisces" LaFramboise. I'm a Pisces Sun (hence the nickname), Taurus Rising and Aquarius Moon. At Pisces Psychic Lenormand, I am committed to helping my clients gain clarity on their journey. I am a 5-star Clairvoyant Psychic Medium and I've been giving psychic readings professionally for the past 18+ years. In addition to my natural clairvoyant abilities, I utilize the art of Lenormand card reading to help my clients find answers to some of the most difficult questions they may have.

​

My readings are tailored to each individual’s needs, and I use my intuition to provide them with guidance and insight into the present, past and future. I am passionate about helping my clients gain insight into their lives, and I believe that my readings can be a powerful tool for self-discovery and personal growth.
